title: Renard to King of Spain, 14 December 1556 (Français 20991 — Renard, ff217v–218r)

steps.what: George Lasry (with ChatGPT Astra 6 and Anthropic Opus 5.5) transcribed and deciphered the item: 2/2 pages transcribed in part; 2/2 cipher pages deciphered in part; 456 elements, 346 identified (75.9%). Report section: see report.

Spot-check against the Gallica image (https://openapi.bnf.fr/iiif/image/v3/ark:/12148/btv1b90643415/f351/full/1600,/0/default.jpg): f217v: heading "Double dune depesche de lambassadeur Renard ... au Roy" and margin "cest une partie de la lre en chiffre dud. Renard dont le dechiffre est apres", followed by 6 rows of mixed letter/syllable signs (que, fo, ma, ta...); excerpt rests on the contemporary decipherment on f218r, which I did not fetch; no sign-level decode done Verdict: partly confirmed.
Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): linked George Lasry's report excerpt (lasry_entry.md); his full transcription and decryption are not in the repository
